note: Revise. Most panels hold up and six held-out questions recomputed independently are correct, but one panel reverses a published result while its targets pass, and several panels plot different quantities from the paper or are checked against expected values taken from our own output. Needed: (1) Figure 2G shows dorsal-ventral genes as more diverged than the 5,000 most variable genes, the opposite of the paper; add that comparison as a target and either fix the method or declare it unreproduced, and correct the instructions that call it reproduced. (2) Figure 2B quadrant counts are 5-21 percent below the paper; the note gives the wrong direction and cause, and the expression filter is tuned rather than the one the authors describe. (3) Figure 4D: neither axis is the paper quantity. (4) Figure 3A: show per-cluster sampling distributions, order the homology columns, and do not blank the olfactory-bulb-like and interpeduncular rows. (5) Figures 2D, 4E (left) and 5C miss the main feature of the published panel: fix or label partial. (6) Replace expected values that are not paper numbers (Figure 6B fold changes, purity and accuracy thresholds, homology concordance). Also: exact or truncation tolerances for counts, pmcid PMC13786409, pack version 0.1.0 for the first public release, contradictory notes in Figures 7B and 7C, instruction wording on excluded tracks and rows, two held-out answers printed in the instructions, and re-record five runs made from a precomputed (numerically identical) pseudobulk file through the pack code path.
